checks.observation: Tab reaches Home, All publications, Catalogs, Application Settings and Import publication. NVDA announces the navigation/list context, control names and Home checked state. NVDA+Tab confirms All publications is focused.
checks.limitations: Sampled default-English Home navigation only. Skip-link activation, heading/landmark quick navigation, route changes, all navigation branches and full focus order are not established.

checks.observation: Enter opens Settings; NVDA reads its title, General/Keyboard shortcuts/Profiles tabs and language combo. Tab and Right Arrow announce selected tab positions. Thorium vanilla is announced as a checked radio, 1 of 1. Two Escapes were issued before the Settings trigger was announced collapsed again.
checks.limitations: Only existing vanilla profile checked; no profile change. First Escape alone did not produce dismissal evidence; possible NVDA focus-mode interaction was not independently proven. Duplicate selected-tab speech was observed. No acoustic assessment or blanket pass for all Settings controls.

checks.observation: NVDA announces Menu (Untitled) as a collapsed button, Enter opens its named dialog and reads its actions, and Escape returns to the named collapsed trigger. The Accessible EPUB 3 link includes title and author.
checks.limitations: Menu actions were read without invoking deletion, loan changes or export. One existing PDF menu and one EPUB link sampled; does not establish every menu or dialog branch.

checks.status: Fixed in sampled local cards; native NVDA verified
checks.observation: Publication controls receive an explicit aria-label built from the same localized title shown on the card, followed by authors. The tooltip uses that same label. Applied to available local, unavailable local and catalog card branches. Five existing local cards expose the expected Chromium AX names. Native NVDA Tab announces Untitled, link; NVDA+Tab confirms Untitled, link, focused. Backward Tab announces Accessible EPUB 3 - Matt Garrish, link and retains its adjacent menu name.
checks.limitations: Fixed and dynamically verified for five existing local cards in English, including the original PDF and an EPUB with author. Catalog and unavailable branches share the source repair but were not dynamically exercised here. All locale, cover and AT variants are not certified. NVDA speech-output logs were inspected; no acoustic assessment. The shared Cover implementation was not changed. Broader Reader native validation remains pending.
checks.baselineStatus: Naming defect reproduced in sampled PDF link
checks.baselineObservation: The visible PDF title is Untitled, but native NVDA focus and browse speech call its opening link To get missing image descriptions, open the context menu. UIA exposes Untitled as its description, not its name. PublicationCard hides its visible title with aria-hidden and relies on title fallback; the decorative cover is exposed with empty alt and presentation role. The adjacent menu remains correctly named.

checks.status: Limited native observation; further Reader checks blocked
checks.observation: After a full npm run start:dev:quick restart, Accessible EPUB 3 loads in the Reader and the EPUB webview is present. NVDA+Tab announces Thorium - Accessible EPUB 3, document, focused, read only. Before restart, two fresh Reader attempts timed out and NVDA announced the native error dialog and OK button.
checks.limitations: Document identification only. No EPUB/PDF reading navigation, Settings sliders, search/status, TOC, editors, print or webview focus transition is passed. Subsequent native input and recovery captures timed out in automatic approval review.

limitations: Partial native NVDA coverage.
